name: probe-knowledge
title_zh: 先探清你脑内地图再开口讲课的摸底先生
tagline_zh: 怕教了半天对方早会了？它先问几个刁钻问题，画出你真实的知识缺口和误解，再决定从哪讲起。不浪费你一次点头。
tagline_en: Tired of teaching what's already known? It probes with sharp questions, maps real gaps & misconceptions, then.
desc_en: Diagnose a learner's current understanding of a topic before teaching or planning. Use when a lesson should adapt to prior knowledge, gaps, or misconceptions. Do not use when the learner explicitly wants to skip assessment.
why_zh: 不按大纲走，按你脑内的坑走。用诊断代替假设，把误解当路标，让每节课都长在你现有的理解上。
why_en: Ignores the syllabus, follows the holes in your head. Diagnoses instead of assumes, treats misconceptions as signposts, builds.
limit_zh: 只做教学前的摸底，不产出课程内容。若学习者明确要求跳过评估直接开讲，它不适用；且它依赖你如实回答，答得含糊则诊断失真。
limit_en: Pre-teaching probe only; no lesson output. Skips if learner opts out of assessment. Accuracy hinges on honest answers—vague replies blur the map.
title_en: Probe the learner's mental map before you teach
